description: This file contains functions for constructing, parsing, and handling systemd unit configuration files, including escaping arguments, rendering environment lines, and parsing exec start commands and environment variable assignments.

methods.name: assertNoSystemdLineBreaks
methods.description: Checks if a string contains CR or LF characters and throws an error if it does.

methods.name: systemdEscapeArg
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in systemd unit files, adding quotes if necessary.

methods.name: renderEnvLines
methods.description: Generates environment variable lines for systemd unit files from a record of key-value pairs.
